project_type: TypeScript Node.js autonomous agent for Solana blockchain revenue generation
build_system: npm + tsc. No Makefile. `npm run build` compiles to dist/. All imports use .js extension (ESM).
test_framework: Vitest with inline describe/it/expect. Tests use tmp SQLite databases via os.tmpdir(). Mocks via vi.mock(). 353 existing tests.
verification_instructions: 1. npm install, 2. npm run build (must succeed with 0 errors), 3. npm test (all tests must pass)
environment_constraints: Node.js v22 available (project requires 24+ but v22 works for build/test). No Docker daemon. Network allows npm install (COMMON_DEPENDENCIES mode assumed based on npm availability).
contribution_requirements: ESM with .js extensions on all imports. Zod for config validation. Winston for logging via createLogger(). SQLite via better-sqlite3. All new modules export from src/core/index.ts. Tests alongside source in tests/ mirroring src/ structure.
key_patterns:
- Each module is a class with constructor dependency injection (memory, llm function, config)
- Logger created per module: createLogger('module-name')
- Database operations via better-sqlite3 synchronous API
- Types defined in src/types/index.ts or module-local types.ts
- Config via src/config.ts with zod schemas and env var defaults
- Tests create temp SQLite DBs, mock external deps (openrouter, config)
- Core modules exported from src/core/index.ts
- Agent uses EventEmitter for alerts
- Scheduler uses node-cron for periodic tasks
directory_structure:
src/core/ - agent, memory, scheduler, risk, mcp, learning, llm-router, wallet
src/strategies/ - 7 revenue strategies (base + implementations)
src/integrations/ - openrouter, solana, jupiter, github, security-scanner
src/telegram/ - bot, alerts, commands/
src/types/ - shared type definitions
tests/ - mirrors src/ structure
